name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Onboarding & Operations Specialist | Documentation, Deadlines & Data Accuracy

Onboarded 25+ clients per month at Wix while leading a team of onboarding specialists, and have spent my career coordinating timelines between customers and internal teams while keeping records accurate and complete. Experienced Excel user who builds tracking, reporting, and automated workflows that keep high-volume processes on schedule.

Build automated intake, reminder, and follow-up workflows that keep deadlines on track without manual chasing.
Track and report performance in Excel, Power BI, and CRM dashboards on a regular cadence.
